name: [POC] SOAR
description: POC vulnerability workflow. Notification path tested; AAP launch, patching, polling, Datadog rescan, and resolved-finding verification are pending end-to-end validation.

parameters.name: query
parameters.value:
SELECT ts,
  status,
  severity,
  resource_id,
  finding_id,
  resource_name,
  remediation_available,
  cve_id,
  package_name,
  installed_version,
  fixed_version,
  advisory_id,
  runtime_active
FROM dd.security_findings(
  columns => ARRAY[
    'timestamp',
    '@status',
    '@severity',
    '@resource_id',
    '@finding_id',
    '@resource_name',
    '@remediation.is_available',
    '@advisory.cve',
    '@package.name',
    '@package.version',
    '@remediation.package.base.version',
    '@advisory.id',
    '@package.is_running'
  ],
  filter => '@status:open @severity:high @remediation.is_available:true @risk.has_exploit_available:true @advisory.cve:*',
  finding_types => ARRAY['host_and_container_vulnerability']
) AS (
  ts TIMESTAMP,
  status VARCHAR,
  severity VARCHAR,
  resource_id VARCHAR,
  finding_id VARCHAR,
  resource_name VARCHAR,
  remediation_available BOOLEAN,
  cve_id VARCHAR,
  package_name VARCHAR,
  installed_version VARCHAR,
  fixed_version VARCHAR,
  advisory_id VARCHAR,
  runtime_active BOOLEAN
)
WHERE cve_id IS NOT NULL
LIMIT 10
